operator_action: Create an empty evidence drop folder and a sidecar CSV with required rev0365 columns.
minimum_artifact_or_note: folder exists; sidecar has filename, artifact_class, custodian_or_source, received_at, scope_jurisdiction, redaction_state, sensitivity_class, linked_request_id
failure_consequence: without sidecar the material is anecdotal only

operator_action: Synchronize device clocks and record timezone/clock source for notes, audio, photo, and file captures.
minimum_artifact_or_note: clock note or screenshot; timezone; device list

operator_action: Capture preliminary findings exactly, including ANS demonstration disposition and deficiency/ARCA/improvement-area status.
minimum_artifact_or_note: raw notes/photo/handout/audio if lawful; speaker role; time observed

operator_action: Ask the on-record questions from RRT-0369-007 without requesting protected details.
minimum_artifact_or_note: question text; answer summary; speaker identity/role if public; time
failure_consequence: answers are candidate evidence only until hashed

operator_action: Collect public handouts/slides or note where official materials will be posted.
minimum_artifact_or_note: handout files/photos or release URL/path; custodian/source
failure_consequence: release path unknown keeps request queue open

operator_action: Copy raw artifacts without editing; compute hashes; preserve original filenames and notes.
minimum_artifact_or_note: sha256, size, raw file path, original media retained
failure_consequence: edited summary cannot be source evidence

operator_action: Complete sidecar rows using linked request IDs and artifact classes from the contract.
minimum_artifact_or_note: sidecar rows complete; no forbidden closure language
failure_consequence: intake CLI will quarantine incomplete rows

operator_action: Run rev0365 intake CLI and store the ledger as a new evidence-intake ledger.
minimum_artifact_or_note: intake command output; ledger CSV; fixture_only=no only for real/lawfully anonymized artifacts

operator_action: Map each received artifact to proofcut status and gap-to-request rows; keep partial artifacts adjudication_pending.
minimum_artifact_or_note: proofcut update; blocker update; rejection reasons if any

operator_action: Dispatch records templates for any unanswered P0 issue by the first business window after meeting.
minimum_artifact_or_note: request copies; submission route; dates; confirmation numbers
